description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminQueue ASP.NET page, handling page load events, session validation, database interactions related to course queues, and navigation buttons for the admin interface.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminQueue ASP.NET page, handling page lifecycle events, session checks, database queries on course queue, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, checks session variables, accesses the database to verify course queue, and potentially deletes entries if the queue is empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the admin panel page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the current page (possibly intended to refresh or be a placeholder for profile navigation).

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by navigating to the login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles the selection of a row in GridView, saves selected student and course IDs to session, and navigates to the answer display page.
